correctness.rationale: The flat totally geodesic boundary gives an intrinsic glide-reflection strip model M_(L,h). Minimizers reduce to nearest even and odd deck lifts with normalized squared lengths E=t²+(u-v)² and O=(1-t)²+(u+v)²; the odd lift wins iff t>1/2+2uv. The normalized horizontal difference t has density 2(1-t); for q=|uv| with half-width ratio w, density is a^-1 log(a/q), a=w²/4. Conditional on the sign of uv, the two crossing probabilities sum to 1-4q for q<1/4 and vanish thereafter. Thus P=1/(2a)∫_0^min(a,1/4)(1-4q)log(a/q)dq, giving P=1/2-w²/8 at w<=1 and (4 log w+3)/(8w²) otherwise. Independent adaptive quadrature matched both branches at w=.2,.7,1,2,4 to better than 1e-11. Differentiation yields strict monotonicity and third-derivative jump 4 at w=1, hence shape determination; area=L²w fixes scale.
